a.lede: The “Steal My Bitcoin” challenge offers a bounty to anyone who can breach a deliberately vulnerable PHP website using the recently disclosed PHP2Shell flaws. The challenge follows previous recoveries of locked Bitcoin fortunes through software vulnerabilities and AI-assisted investigation, but no successful claim has been confirmed.
a.title: Bitcoin reward offered to anyone who could break into an unpatched server running PHP, hacker cracks site and claims bounty

b.lede: Websites were taken offline after the developers of programming language PHP said "critical vulnerabilities" had been discovered.
b.title: Race to update services' computer systems after cyber-security flaw found
